title: BeatSheet
description: The creative core: N beats, each one visual intention attached to one span of the video. Produced by the beat planner agent or a human; consumed by the compiler.

version.description: 1.1 adds per-beat queries[] (D53); 1.2 adds per-beat transition_out (D89). Older sheets stay valid and resolve exactly as before — a beat that names no transition takes the style pack's default, which is what every beat did before 1.2 — and a human may still drop a hand-written beats.json in.

script_text.description: narration beats only: a verbatim contiguous span of the script

visual_intent.description: scout-style concrete visual description. The SEMANTIC search query (the library embeds it) and the image-generation prompt; keyword stock search uses queries[] instead

queries.description: v1.1 (D53): 2-3 short KEYWORD queries, subject first, for stock libraries that match words rather than meaning. Tried in order; the first that returns an acceptable asset wins. Absent (or v1.0) means keywords are derived from visual_intent instead.

mood.description: emotional register of this beat, driving background music (D48). Vocabulary: neutral, tense, somber, hopeful, urgent, triumphant, reflective, playful. Deliberately a string and not an enum: an unrecognised mood degrades to neutral in the compiler rather than failing a video over a word choice.

transition_out.description: D89 — how this beat HANDS OVER to the next one, overriding style_pack.transitions.default. The boundary belongs to the outgoing beat, the same way the plan's VisualItem.transition_out does, so a junction has exactly one owner. Omitted means the pack's default. Must be in style_pack.transitions.allowed. Ignored on the last beat, which has no junction; on a beat the compiler splits into several shots it applies to the last of them.

source_words.description: verbatim words in this beat's span the anchor was detected from

component.description: MUST exist in the component catalog

anchor_ref.description: index into this beat's anchors; overlays may only reference an anchor or carry pure text

props_hint.description: partial props; the compiler fills the rest from the anchor + defaults

emphasis.description: DEPRECATED (D86) — superseded by `role`, which says the same thing without colliding with the catalog's `emphasis` PROP (a visual weight the theme owns). Still declared and still read, because `additionalProperties: false` makes an undeclared field a hard rejection and hand-written sheets on disk are an artifact a human may upload (D62). `true` is equivalent to `role: "emphasis"`; `role` wins when both are present. New sheets should write `role`.

role.description: Which of the two reasons this overlay exists (D86). `anchor` carries a fact the narration says and must reference one of the beat's anchors; `emphasis` lifts a moment with pure text and answers salience instead, on its own separately rate-limited budget (D59), off unless the style pack enables it. Replaces the deprecated `emphasis` boolean, which is still read when `role` is absent — `role` wins when both are present. A component whose catalog anchor_types are EMPTY carries no fact by construction and is treated as emphasis whatever this field says, so `role: anchor` on one is a violation rather than a silent reclassification.
